# Structure

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/principles/structure.md`.

- PRIN-24 prefer: Keep entry points thin: initialize, load config, wire, run; put logic in packages or modules. [tool:golangci-lint]
- PRIN-25 prefer: Read configuration once, in one place, into a typed structure; keep per-site or per-host facts out of code and templates, as variables or data inputs.
- PRIN-26 must: Never commit a secret in clear; deliver secrets through a secret store, an external secret object or an out-of-band file. [tool:gitleaks]
  Good: `kind: ExternalSecret` that references `remoteRef.key: app/db-password`.
  Bad: `password: hunter2` in a values file.
- PRIN-27 prefer: Keep control flow flat: guard clauses and early returns instead of nesting. [tool:golangci-lint]
- PRIN-28 prefer: Make scripts and resource definitions safe to run again.
